378: A native of Man-Home, Akari is a happy and easy-going person, who we rarely see angry or upset, a quality which she shares with her supervisor. She is best described as a romantic and seems to find enjoyment in things or events that other people might think humdrum and mundane.
379: The only other undine with Aria Company, Alicia is one of the Three Water Fairies of Neo-Venezia, known by the title "Snow White". At the start of the series, she is the most popular undine in the city, noted especially for her graceful rowing style.
380: The first friend Akari ever made on Aqua, Aika is an undine for Himeya, the oldest and currently second-ranking water-guide company in Neo-Venezia.
381: Akira is one of Neo Venezia's three Water Fairies, and is Aika's supervisor with the Himeya company. She is nicknamed the Demon Instructor for her strict training regimen as well as her loud and brusque personality.
382: A girl introduced in volume 3, Alice is a trainee for Orange Planet, a company who currently holds the first place in the water guide business.
383: The third "Water Fairy", who works for Orange Planet and acts as Alice's mentor. She tends to be a total airhead who does not really pay attention to anything (in the anime, she once rowed under a bridge and forgot to duck), but genuinely cares about Alice.
4786: Amongst the undine companies, it's a tradition to keep a blue-eyed cat (breed is not a problem here) as mascot for good luck. President Aria is the Aria Company's mascot, a male Aqua breed feline (common trait are bigger than Earth breed and human-level intelligence).
8803: Maa is one of the four major cats in the Aria storyline was adopted as a stray by Alice in the first season. She named her "Maa-kun" because all the cat said was "Maa".
10710: Akari's first customer as a Single. He is a tall, impatient young man who calls Akari "Pigtails" (momiko) to tease her. He works as an apprentice Salamander, someone who helps maintain Aqua's climate in the floating buildings that tethered overhead.
10711: A famous and longest-serving Prima undine, who started Aria company with Aria Pokoteng after realizing she was missing too much of life as Himeya's top ace. She was Prima undine for 30 years and mentor to Alicia, her last disciple, to whom she left the company on her retirement.
10712: President of Himeya Company, a small, delicate, black female cat from Manhome. She is the target of President Aria's obvious crush (and sometimes lack of manners), wherein she makes it a point to ignore him for the most part.
12388: A girl from Man-home. Initially, Ai came to Aqua to explore in a rather negative attitude because her elder sister often boasted to her how good Aqua is, only to find that it was boring. However, meeting & befriending Akari & friends changed Ai's mindset.
13417: Woody is a Sylph. His job is to deliver packages and other goods to people in Neo-Venezia, or delivering people's treasured feelings as he called it. He loves 'swimming' through the sky, and prefers his nickname because it's less formal than his actual name.
14141: Al is an apprentice gnome (a person that maintains the gravity levels if Aqua to match that of Man-Home).
17172: Akatsuki's older brother, who works in the trading business and is known to travel back and forth between Aqua and Man-Home. He considers himself to be among the elite, and enjoys antagonizing his brother from time to time when they meet.
17270: He is one of the postmen working on planet Aqua. He was the first person Akari Mizunashi met when she came to the planet, and also the one who brought her then sleeping self over to Aria company when he learned she would start working there.
30555: A spirit of a cat in form of a girl. Akari and President Aria meets her in episode 4 of Aria the Animation ("That undeliverable letter") where she tasks Akari with delivering a letter to an address she couldn't locate on her computer.
30557: A tourist from Man-Home/Earth who rented Akira's gondola in episode 7 of Aria the Animation. ("Doing that Wonderful Job") She is traveling with her husband, whom she also met on Man-Home.
30558: Amelie's husband. While he doesn't seem to mind traveling alongside his wife, he's seemingly more interested in reading about the various sights and happenings around Neo-Venezia. He has a slight temper, and at first heavily underestimated the work it took to become a Prima.
30812: A person from the past who appears when Akari is visiting a bridge. Acts the same as Akari and may be regarded as an alternate of her. It's hinted in the anime that she's a teacher of sorts. Akiko is an anime-only character, and does not show up in the manga.
